verdict.rationale: Kimi documents a public API: the Kimi Code API is compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, members can create API keys in the Kimi Code Console, and a separate developer LLM API platform exists. However, the probe found no public API for the Kimi assistant app itself, and the platform.kimi.ai API is a separate pay-as-you-go product, so the API gives model access rather than control of the product's agent, research or PPT features. Missing for 10: a documented API for driving the assistant app's own features (agent tasks, deep research, scheduled tasks), an agent-facing docs index (llms.txt) for kimi.com, and independent hands-on corroboration of the Kimi Code API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
